messages.content:
You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value (as written, then in normal form in brackets), sometimes a condition,
and the place it comes from. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: When must guards for moving transmission parts be interlocking movable guards instead of fixed guards?

Facts:
[0] Guards protecting persons against hazards from moving transmission parts — shall be — interlocking movable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.2 (interlocking movable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.2) [condition: one of two alternatives, the other being fixed guards] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.1]
[1] Guards designed to protect persons against moving transmission parts — mustBe — interlocking movable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.2 (interlocking movable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.2) [condition: either this or fixed guards] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.1]
[2] Guards protecting persons against hazards from moving transmission parts — shall be — fixed guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.1 (fixed guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.1) [condition: one of two alternatives, the other being interlocking movable guards] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.1]
[3] Guards designed to protect persons against moving transmission parts — mustBe — fixed guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.1 (fixed guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.1) [condition: either this or interlocking movable guards] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.1]
[4] Guards or protective devices for moving parts involved in the process — shall be — interlocking movable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.2 (interlocking movable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.2) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[5] Interlocking movable guards — shall be used — where frequent access is envisaged (where frequent access is envisaged) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.1]
[6] Guards or protective devices against moving parts in the process — must be — fixed guards (1.4.2.1), interlocking movable guards (1.4.2.2), protective devices (1.4.3), or a combination (fixed guards (1.4.2.1), interlocking movable guards (1.4.2.2), protective devices (1.4.3), or a combination) [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.2]
[7] Moving parts directly involved in the process that cannot be made completely inaccessible during operation — must be fitted with — fixed guards or interlocking movable guards preventing access to sections not used in the work (fixed guards or interlocking movable guards preventing access to sections not used in the work) [condition: when operations requiring operator intervention make complete inaccessibility impossible] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.2]
[8] Such parts — shall be fitted with — fixed guards or interlocking movable guards preventing access to sections of the parts not used in the work (fixed guards or interlocking movable guards preventing access to sections of the parts not used in the work) [condition: when certain moving parts cannot be made completely inaccessible owing to operator intervention] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[9] Guards or protective devices for moving parts involved in the process — shall be — fixed guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.1 (fixed guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.1) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[10] Interlocking movable guards — mustBeAdjustableOnlyIntentionally — guard adjustment (guard adjustment) [DIR, Annex I, 1.4.2.2]
[11] Interlocking movable guards — shouldBeUsedWhen — frequent access is envisaged (frequent access is envisaged) [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.1]
[12] Moving parts in the situation above — must be fitted with — adjustable guards (1.4.2.3) restricting access to sections where access is necessary (adjustable guards (1.4.2.3) restricting access to sections where access is necessary) [condition: when operations requiring operator intervention make complete inaccessibility impossible] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.2]
[13] Interlocking movable guards — mustRemainAttachedWhenOpen — machinery (machinery) [condition: as far as possible] [DIR, Annex I, 1.4.2.2]
[14] Outside parts of the guard — must be arranged so they cannot turn — with the removable mechanical transmission device (with the removable mechanical transmission device) [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.7]
[15] Moveable guards preventing access to moving parts in engine compartment — doNotNeedInterlockingDevices — interlocking devices (interlocking devices) [condition: they have to be opened either by the use of a tool or key or by a control located in the driving position] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.2]
[16] Moving parts of machinery — must be fitted with — guards or protective devices (guards or protective devices) [condition: where risks persist despite design measures] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.7]
[17] Such parts — shall be fitted with — adjustable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.3 restricting access to sections where access is necessary (adjustable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.3 restricting access to sections where access is necessary) [condition: when certain moving parts cannot be made completely inaccessible owing to operator intervention] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[18] Interlocking movable guards — shallBeAdjustableOnlyIntentionally — adjustment only by intentional action (adjustment only by intentional action) [REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.2]
[19] Interlocking movable guards — shallRemainAttachedWhenOpen — attached to the machinery or related product (attached to the machinery or related product) [condition: as far as possible] [REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.2]
[20] Guards — shall be fitted with — an interlocking device with guard locking controlled by the position of the carrier (an interlocking device with guard locking controlled by the position of the carrier) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.8.5]
[21] Moveable guards preventing access to moving parts in the engine compartment — needNotHave — interlocking devices (interlocking devices) [condition: they have to be opened either by the use of a tool or key or by a control located in the driving position] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.2]
[22] Guards or protective devices for moving parts involved in the process — shall be — a combination of the above (a combination of the above) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[23] Adjustable guards restricting access — restrictAccessTo — those areas of the moving parts strictly necessary for the work (those areas of the moving parts strictly necessary for the work) [REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.3]
[24] Movable guards — shallHaveGuardLockingDevice — guard locking device in addition to an interlocking device (guard locking device in addition to an interlocking device) [condition: where an operator can reach the danger zone before the risk has ceased] [REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.2]
[25] Outside parts of the guard — shall be designed so that they — cannot turn with the removable transmission device (cannot turn with the removable transmission device) [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[26] Removable mechanical transmission devices — must be designed so — any moving part is protected over its whole length (any moving part is protected over its whole length) [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.7]
[27] Adjustable guards — mustRestrictAccessTo — those areas of the moving parts strictly necessary for the work (those areas of the moving parts strictly necessary for the work) [DIR, Annex I, 1.4.2.3]
[28] Guards — must be fitted with — an interlocking device controlled by the position of the carrier (an interlocking device controlled by the position of the carrier) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.5]
[29] Removable mechanical transmission devices — shall be designed so that — any moving part is protected (any moving part is protected) [condition: over its whole length] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[30] power-operated interlocking movable guards — listedIn — Annex I, Part B, point 16 (Annex I, Part B, point 16) [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 16]
[31] Interlocking device — prevents — hazardous movements of the carrier (hazardous movements of the carrier) [condition: until the guards are closed and locked] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.8.5]
[32] Removable mechanical transmission devices including their guards — isListedIn — Annex IV point 14 (Annex IV point 14) [DIR, Annex IV]
[33] moving parts where risks persist — shall be fitted with — guards or protective devices (guards or protective devices) [condition: where risks persist] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.7]
[34] power-operated interlocking movable guards — designedAs — safeguards for machinery referred to in points 9, 10 and 11 of this Part (safeguards for machinery referred to in points 9, 10 and 11 of this Part) [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 16]
[35] Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices — isListedAs — safety component (safety component) [DIR, Annex V]
[36] Guards or protective devices for moving parts involved in the process — shall be — protective devices as referred to in section 1.4.3 (protective devices as referred to in section 1.4.3) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[37] Interlocking device — prevents — hazardous movements of the carrier (hazardous movements of the carrier) [condition: until the guards are closed and locked] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.5]
[38] Guard on power take-off — must be openable — for access to the removable transmission device (for access to the removable transmission device) [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.7]
[39] Guard — must cover the transmission — to the ends of the inner jaws (to the ends of the inner jaws) [condition: simple universal joints] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.7]
[40] guards or protective devices for moving parts — shallBeSelectedOnBasisOf — type of risk (type of risk) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8]
[41] Interlocking movable guards — mustFailSafe — starting or stopping of hazardous machinery functions (starting or stopping of hazardous machinery functions) [condition: absence or failure of one component] [DIR, Annex I, 1.4.2.2]
[42] Guard — must cover the transmission — at least to the centre of the outer joint or joints (at least to the centre of the outer joint or joints) [condition: wide-angle universal joints] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.7]
[43] Recipient machinery needing a removable transmission device — must have an attaching system — preventing damage to the device and guard from ground or machinery contact (preventing damage to the device and guard from ground or machinery contact) [condition: when the machinery is uncoupled] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.7]
[44] Interlocking movable guards — shallBeDesignedSoFailureStopsOrPreventsStart — starting or stopping hazardous functions (starting or stopping hazardous functions) [condition: absence or failure of one of their components] [REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.2]
[45] Power take-off guard — shall be — openable for access to the removable transmission device (openable for access to the removable transmission device) [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[46] Adjustable guards — mustBeAdjustable — manually or automatically (manually or automatically) [condition: depending on the type of work involved] [DIR, Annex I, 1.4.2.3]
[47] Shaft guards — must not be usable as steps — unless designed and constructed for that purpose (unless designed and constructed for that purpose) [condition: access means provided near the removable transmission device] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.7]
[48] Guard on power take-off — must leave enough room — to prevent the drive shaft damaging the guard (to prevent the drive shaft damaging the guard) [condition: when the machinery or tractor is moving, once the guard is in place] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.7]
[49] Parts required in particular positions for safe movement — driver provided means of checking position — before moving the machinery (before moving the machinery) [condition: parts that must be in particular positions, locked if necessary] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.2]
[50] Increased stopping times — canRequire — safeguarding modification, possibly with installation changes (safeguarding modification, possibly with installation changes) [ur10e-manual, p. 211]
[51] People staying between protective device and hazardous point without being detected — requireAdditional — additional protective measures (e.g. restart interlock) (additional protective measures (e.g. restart interlock)) [condition: people can stay between the protective device and the hazardous point without being detected] [nanoscan3-manual, p. 22]
[52] Robot installation in hazardous application — safeguardingRequired — safeguarding (safeguarding) [condition: hazards cannot be reasonably eliminated or risks cannot be sufficiently reduced by built-in safety-related functions] [ur10e-manual, p. 185]
[53] Parts to be transported — must be suspended or loaded — properly and in a fall-proof manner (properly and in a fall-proof manner) [mastar-manual, p. 12]
[54] Lista Allegati A e B — può subire variazioni — in numero e ubicazione (in numero e ubicazione) [condition: in caso di indisponibilità, dismissioni o nuove acquisizioni di apparecchi di sollevamento] [igea-equipment, p. 4]
[55] verifiche periodiche — must follow — D.lgs. 81/08 and D.M. 11 aprile 2011 procedures in All. VII (D.lgs. 81/08 and D.M. 11 aprile 2011 procedures in All. VII) [igea-equipment, p. 5]
[56] ubicazione degli apparecchi — è indicata in — Allegato B (Allegato B) [igea-equipment, p. 3]
[57] verifica periodica — segue le cadenze — previste dall'Allegato VII del D.Lgs. 81/08 (previste dall'Allegato VII del D.Lgs. 81/08) [igea-equipment, p. 3]

Facts 5 and 11 give the condition: interlocking movable guards shall be used, or should be used, where frequent access is envisaged. No dates are attached, so no date comparison applies.", "kind": "text", "value": "Interlocking movable guards are required where frequent access is envisaged.", "text": "Under Annex III point 1.3.8.1 (and Annex I point 1.3.8.1), guards for moving transmission parts must be interlocking movable guards rather than fixed guards where frequent access is envisaged.", "used": [0, 1, 5, 11]}
